scripts.check: pnpm -r check && pnpm exec biome check packages
scripts.test: node packages/core/scripts/validate.ts && node packages/cli/src/main.ts corpus/pdfs --quiet; rc=$?; test $rc -eq 1
scripts.corpus: uv run tools/generate/make_corpus.py && uv run tools/generate/make_corpus_word.py
scripts.corpus:check: uv run --project tools/generate ruff check tools/generate && uv run --project tools/generate ty check tools/generate
